input.free_text_description: The system operates in the user management, authentication domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include blog, blog error, comment. Core business data revolves around Comment, Post, Role, User.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and publish blog articles, so that I can share written content with my audience.
As a User, I want to comment on posts, so that I can participate in discussions and provide feedback.
As a User, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a User, I want to create and browse posts, so that I can share content and discover what others have published.
As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
